Keep everything. Finish the interface, the feedback and check the template.

HUD (anchored to visible screen edges + safe margin)
- Top-left: score (large), lives below as small paddle icons in player color.
- Top-center: "Level 2/3" (text.level). Under it, one small hexagon icon + shrinking timer bar per active timed power-up.
- Top-right: pause button.
- During serve: text.tapToLaunch above the paddle in textMuted.
Rebuild HUD strings only when values change.

SCREENS
- Title: attract mode with the level 1 grid and a ball bouncing on its own (no score, no lives), title, best, control hints text.controlsKeyboard / text.controlsTouch (highlight the last input type used), text.tapToStart.
- LEVEL_CLEAR: text.levelClear, score so far, continue on tap or Space.
- Result: text.win or text.lose, score, best with "New best!" when beaten, level reached, buttons Play again and Menu.

FEEDBACK AND SOUND (values from style.feedback and audio.sfx)
- Launch: action sound. Paddle hit: paddle squash + paddle sound. Wall hit: wall sound.
- Block damaged: flash + blockHit. Block destroyed: burst in the block color, "+N" popup, destroy sound.
- Power-up caught: burst + powerup sound. Ball lost: shake + ballLost. Level clear: levelClear sound. Result: win or lose.
Damaged blocks drawn with alpha 0.45 + 0.55*hp/maxHp. Draw blocks grouped by color in one pass; redraw the grid to an offscreen canvas only when a block changes.

DEBUG OVERLAY (when debug.showFps)
FPS, balls, blocks left, current ball speed, substeps per step. debug.invincible: the bottom becomes a wall.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (fix anything that fails, then report)
1. Paddle works with arrows/A/D, click-drag, touch drag, and plain mouse move when input.mouseFollow is true.
2. Launch with Space/Up/W, click or tap; dragging never launches.
3. Center hit goes straight up, edge hit at maxBounceAngle; the ball never loops horizontally.
4. 5 minutes at 1400 u/s with debug.invincible: no tunneling through blocks, paddle or walls; at least 30 FPS.
5. Blocks need hp hits, steel never breaks, levels clear without steel, 3 levels then win with life bonus.
6. widePaddle, multiBall and slowBall work; timers refresh without stacking; effects end on life loss.
7. Editing a row string in levels.list changes the grid.
8. Score shown = value sent with sendScore = best saved; highestLevel saved.
9. Layout correct at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 32:9; full game playable with keyboard only and touch only.
10. No value hard-coded outside game_spec.json, no console errors, no network requests.
List the game_spec.json keys you added in this step, if any.
